substrate: ProcessExecutionTask (governed): route -> actionOwner -> approvalLevel -> requiredEvidence -> completionControl -> auditEvent -> reassessment. Persist/read/apply in src/services/owner-mode/process-execution-bridge.service.ts.

modules.managerStaffAction: Manager/staff complete correction/review tasks with evidence.
modules.opsiqDraftPrepExecution: OpsIQ drafts evidence requests and SOP/checklist changes.
modules.reassessmentVerification: Completing correction/SOP/training/reassessment routes opens a governed reassessment.

modules.ownerActionRequired: Owner reviews material cash/profit protective actions.
modules.managerStaffAction: Manager acts on non-material protective actions.
modules.opsiqDraftPrepExecution: Data gaps route to a data task (never a fabricated cash figure).
modules.reassessmentVerification: Reassessment on request; re-check when the owner acts or data is captured.

modules.routeApiEvidence: bridgeWorkloadFinding -> wl:<workloadType> (CREATE_MANAGER_TASK / CREATE_OWNER_APPROVAL_TASK / CREATE_SOP_CHECKLIST_TASK / CREATE_TRAINING_TASK / CREATE_EVIDENCE_REQUEST / CREATE_MISSING_DATA_TASK)
modules.managerStaffAction: DELEGATE_TO_MANAGER -> manager task; data collection -> staff.
modules.evidenceRequirement: Evidence-gated completion; no fabricated time-saving in any owner-visible text.

modules.routeApiEvidence: bridgeCapabilityRecommendation -> cap:<capabilityType> (data gap -> CREATE_MISSING_DATA_TASK; material+unlocks -> CREATE_OWNER_APPROVAL_TASK; material/blocking -> CREATE_CORRECTION_TASK prep; else MONITOR_ONLY)
modules.ownerActionRequired: Material capability builds that unlock automation are OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
modules.opsiqDraftPrepExecution: OpsIQ prepares the drafted capability/prep note.
modules.remainingAdvisoryOnly: Low-value / non-blocking capability recommendations stay MONITOR_ONLY (deliberate anti-flood safety design, not an advisory gap).

modules.routeApiEvidence: bridgeSopDraft -> sop:<sourceCorrectionKey> (CREATE_SOP_CHECKLIST_TASK). Collapses the generic pc: SOP route for the same fix.
modules.evidenceRequirement: Requires the drafted change + evidence of adoption before completion.

modules.routeApiEvidence: bridgeTrainingAssignment -> tr:<sourceKey>:<trainingType> (CREATE_TRAINING_TASK; data-briefing -> CREATE_MISSING_DATA_TASK). Collapses the generic pc: training route.
modules.ownerActionRequired: OWNER-approval trainings (e.g. manager-review coaching) stay owner-gated.
modules.managerStaffAction: Manager/staff owner assigned from assignedRole; completion proof required.
modules.evidenceRequirement: Requires proof the coaching was completed; no discipline language.
modules.reassessmentVerification: Verify the coaching landed after reviewAfterDays.

modules.routeApiEvidence: bridgeEffectivenessEvaluation -> eff:<sourceCorrectionKey> (IMPROVED -> MONITOR_ONLY; WORSENED/UNCHANGED -> RETRAIN/MODIFY/ESCALATE evidence-gated; INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> data task)
modules.managerStaffAction: RETRAIN -> manager training; MODIFY -> SOP change.
modules.evidenceRequirement: Actionable re-checks require adherence + before/after evidence; a verified IMPROVED re-check is MONITOR_ONLY and cannot be completed to fake effectiveness.
modules.reassessmentVerification: This module IS the verification leg.
modules.remainingAdvisoryOnly: Adherence expressed via effectiveness direction rather than a dedicated persisted adherence enum; requires a prior snapshot baseline.

modules.routeApiEvidence: QUALITY_FAILURE_LOOP -> ESCALATE_TO_OWNER; REWORK_LOOP -> REVIEW_PROCESS_STEP; RESOLVE_OPERATIONAL_EVENT -> CREATE_REASSESSMENT_TASK
modules.uiEvidence: Panel family 'Process fix' (owner-approval language for reputation risk)
modules.opsiqDraftPrepExecution: Reassessment task opened on the complaint events.
modules.evidenceRequirement: Evidence-gated completion; NO auto-customer-contact, NO auto-discount, NO spend/tender/contract/payroll.
modules.remainingAdvisoryOnly: Routed via correction-router finding types, not a dedicated complaint-intake channel.

cockpitOverloadControl: buildProcessExecutionBridge yields a single topRoute (most-severe ACTIONABLE route; MONITOR_ONLY never leads); the rest collapse under a 'more' disclosure. Specific SOP/training routes collapse the generic correction route for the same fix (no duplicate).
safetyInvariantsHeld: Owner-only material decisions cannot be approved/rejected/delegated by a non-owner (isOwnerOnly).
MONITOR_ONLY / BLOCK_UNSAFE_ACTION have no interactive/completable action.
Wrong workspace / unauthorized fail closed (OWNER_MANAGE + requireWorkspace).
No fabricated money / profit / ROI / win-probability / time-saving; no hidden score; no auto customer-contact / spend / tender / contract / payroll.
